readBy: the builder of Round 1218, desktop Claude lane
method: Each page was opened on the read day through a page reader that answers with lines quoted from the page. Every literal in the ledger is a line that reader quoted. A figure is the number printed in its literal.
limits: No copy of a page was kept, so there is no snapshot hash. A reader who doubts a figure opens the url and finds the literal.
The Premier League rows are one journalist's tally of overturned decisions. The league publishes no split of its own that was found.
The Serie A row is the first season under review (2017-18), before semi automated offside. It is the lowest reading of goals ruled out and so it sets that target.
Matches a season is arithmetic on the league's size, not a figure read on the page, except where the literal prints it.
